integrity: The new contribution is the complete 7-vertex rank-three spectrum, not the previously established 7-vertex onset, 6-edge minimum, or unrolled rank criterion. Complete Burnside edge-orbit enumeration and a separate direct-rank atlas check are included. The work is reviewed by its producing model only; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only simple uncoloured undirected graphs on exactly seven vertices. It does not classify higher orders, determine the separate universal forcing cutoff, or establish absolute historical novelty.
title: The complete seven-vertex extension-rank-three graph spectrum
